description: The epoch record of SEALED.md section 5. `epoch_1` is built from the inputs given; `epoch_2` follows it. Each refusal is a record offered as epoch 2 to the checking device, which holds epoch_1 as the previous record and has checked the device lists in `lists_checked`.

refusals.why: bytes left over after the record
the record is for another conversation
the key epoch is not one above the previous record's
prev is not the hash of the previous record's stored bytes
the record names an account that is not in the chat
a list hash is not the hash of that version
a list version lower than in the previous record
a list version the device has not been able to check
a device of the lists is left out of the recipients
a recipient is filed under the wrong account
the maker is not one of the recipients
the signature is not by the maker's signing key
a byte of the record changed after it was signed
the device's sealed value does not open
the secret the device opens is not the one the record's check announces
